title: Flipped-grid stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 with a run gate at 123.937471813960209: de987687 with one gate coin (K/2^64 = 0.5402) and a longer opened run

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins: one fresh 64-bit coin opens the run with probability K/2^64, K = 9965960903075989951, and an opened run succeeds with probability at least the exact rational lo_run computed by certificate.py (its displayed lower bound is 0.7218802339), and the product of that exact rational with K/2^64 is at least 0.39 (proof.md 2.4, success.md 6.7; Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs, conditioning on points; drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry and weak-operand sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows; success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^123.937471813960209 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit), 2^7 + (K/2^64) E_run with an opened run's work at most 169.0085 per leaf E-averaged over 320 groups of Y-batches that stop at the first resolving group, with every walk, key path, main-pair K2 verification and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^189.296072 instructions, is disclosed. Each of 2^72 nodes keeps 256 permanent points X with 1280 one-TiB lookup tables (built by tbld8, charged) and generates each batch's 2^17 points Y = C + [m t + n s]P with one shared inverse per step (ygen, charged); six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y) per incidence come from one batched inverse per pair of X's (fwd 76.63 and bwd 1140.71 instructions per incidence by LD64B table lookups) and are labelled by 128-bit truncated fraction products (sections 3.1-3.3); records travel two hops in 256-record blocks and join by hash chains at hop-2 arrival (sections 2, 4); every delivery is charged as executed code, with FEAT_LS64 at the locations of section 2.1 and DC ZVA on 256-byte blocks (DCZID_EL0.BS = 6). Peak memory at most 2^135.9991 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^116.1487 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks every declared figure and every ledger row. Built on de987687 (machine-valid, review) (124.431828273610719), with the run gate of kaankolcu's p256 1e5413b0 (credited); de987687 built on 5aacf299; the flipped grid, X-pair partial fractions, the u/v split and lookups are soispoke's 7f4f73d0 and 17a007c8 (credited, proof.md section 9); no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break. Direct parent: ad9027be (evaluated commit 756cbcf2dac6673497fcf669325712bbe50f144a); the horizon, gate and ledger are recalculated here.

experiments.purpose: Flip kernels (fwd, bwd, keys) on production points against bit-exact models (fractions, bounds, Fourier identity, records, indices, labels), ygen's Y-records and tbld8's tables against exact references, the 3.4 sites, weak operands and fixups (sites.py), both hops and the join on a 4 x 4 machine with LS64/ISA failing tests (machine.py), every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
